reviews.text: December 2013 weather was freezing cold. The wind is the killer. Still, we had a great time at this pedestrian street that you can walk through and not get bored. It's crowded even though it's cold outside. The shops here are great.

We were here in late August. They developed it so well as local pedestrian street but I will never ever go to Shanghai in summer for vacation ever again. It’s hot like hell. There is no AC can actually can stop me from feeling sticky at noon (it was 35° when I was there, cannot imagine how it’s like in July ) and evening is still hot like in the morning. But aside from that, the atmosphere, the food, the shop and the restaurant is awesome. 🙌🏼

Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street (南京路步行街) 🌆🛍️ Shanghai’s buzzing shopping hub! From The Bund to People’s Square, enjoy neon lights 🌃, street performers 🎭, historic shops 🏛️ & modern malls 🏬 Great for shopping, snacks 🥟 & photos 📸. Always lively — nights are magical ✨!

The best walking street I've been to...I have never seen anything like this in other countries. I love the place and it's magnificent structures and architecture. This is definitely one of the finest place I've seen.

Neon lights galore. 2-D 3D animation. Shopping, Eating, People watching - this is Nanjing Pedestrian Road. Note: It's crowded at night. You can walk up to the Bund but it is quite a long walk. You can take the "electric train" for Y5 pp.

A classic, historical road that has become a shoppers haven and a place for people to window shop and shop. It is a wide road with no cars, only people to stroll and explore the beautiful upscale Chinese and foreign brands with the exception of the intersecting streets. It is where some of the best showrooms in the country are located, I think. There are also, entrance and exits to Metro Stations. Some of which are staircase only.

One of the Top-5 must see, must visit tourist destinations in Shanghai, to me. Plus it is a good place to shop, dine, sight seeing and crowd watching. So many stores, brands, interesting shops, important sites, and cool restaurants to visit (from the old, traditional to the hip and trendy). You can start from the Bund side and walk toward the West end. Or starts from the West and Walk toward East Nanjing Road to the Bund and ends with spectacular views of modern Pudong Shanghai’s skyline in the background. Very photogenic (and full of people) at night.

The Nanjing Road is Shanghai's famous shopping street, conveniently located right where my hotel, the Shanghai EDITION, is situated. From luxury boutiques to bustling markets, this vibrant street has it all. Whether you're hunting for souvenirs, designer goods, or simply enjoying the lively atmosphere, Nanjing Road offers an unforgettable shopping experience right at your doorstep.

China's premier shopping street, the 5.5-km-long (3.4-mile-long) Nanjing Road, starts at the Bund in the east and ends in the west at the junction of Jing'an Temple and West Yan'an Street. Today it is a must-see metropolitan destination attracting thousands of fashion-seeking shoppers from all over the world. As a century-old shopping street in Huangpu District, Shanghai, Nanjing Road was a witness of the city's history. Over time, it has been restructured, undergoing significant changes. Big traditional stores no longer dominate the market since modern shopping malls, specialty stores, theaters, and international hotels have mushroomed on both sides of the street. For shopping convenience, its eastern end has an all-weather pedestrian arcade.

Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street, the most iconic shopping street in Shanghai. It's one of the world's longest, over 5km in length, stretching from The Bund in the East to the junction of Jing'an Temple & West Yan'an Street.
With a lot of shops to choose from. Observed with higher prices compared to other areas. The nanjing road pedestrian street is good for walking since it is closed to vehicles.
The nation-famous/world-famous pedestrian street, arrayed with multiple shops, plazas, restaurants, hotels. At The east end of the street is the fabulous bund area
Very good place for shopping and near to the river. Variety of foods, high end stores and huge crowd can be expected.
When in Shanghai it is a must place to visit. It's a great starting point to walk to the bund.
A very pleasant shopping street. Plenty of street food and local delights to try along the way. Wonderful pedestrian street and local experience.

Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street is a very crowded shopping street, but that just adds to its lively atmosphere! You can buy everything here, from fashion and electronics to souvenirs and local snacks. The roads are clean, and the humidity feels just right, making it a comfortable place to explore. Overall, it was a great experience, and I would highly recommend it to anyone visiting Shanghai!

Do drop by and have a walk if you have the time. nice pedestrian street with stretch of shops and retails.. there are also restaurants too.. especially we found the white rabbit shop here with vast flavours..

Una delle strade per lo shopping piu belle al mondo. Tutti i grandi brand della moda si susseguono tra insegne giganti luminose, negozi di cibo e viuzze che si incrociano offrendo artigianato ed altro cibo locale. Strada lunghissima che incrociando People’s Square arriva a The Bund per godere la vista de grattacieli. Comodissimo arrivarci con la metro linea verde 2.
